title: Two Machine-Checked Conditional Routes to the Riemann Hypothesis: A Formalized Fekete Criterion, Effective Positivity Targets, and an Exact-Ready Receptor Architecture
description:
This preprint presents a Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization scaffold for two conditional routes to the Riemann Hypothesis. It records a machine-checked generic Grassmann/Fekete Toeplitz closure, exact-ready effective and Jensen receptors, numerical diagnostics, and a theorem-status ledger. The manuscript does not prove the Riemann Hypothesis; the remaining analytic inputs are explicitly named and are not axiomatized.

Changes in 0.2.0. Positions the work against Katkova's classical Xi/PF criterion and the 2026 cubic tail-wedge preprint (arXiv:2607.16795), which is cited as an external result and not counted among the audited Lean theorems. The Route A frontier is restated as a complementary finite-prefix wedge. The arbitrary-row minor scan is extended to the row-48 box and replicated independently in Python, JavaScript and TypeScript. The axiom audit now covers 122 theorems, all depending only on Lean's three foundational axioms.
